content: One who listens deeply learns ten times faster than one who speaks constantly.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Kiku wa ittoki no haji, kikanu wa matsudai no haji
explanation: When you speak, you are merely repeating what you already know. When you listen with an open, unhurried mind, you receive what the entire universe has spent centuries refining. Wisdom enters through silent ears and an open heart.
practicalInsight: In your next conversation, let the other person finish their entire thought before you even begin formulating a response.
reflectionPrompt: Are you truly listening to the people around you, or just waiting for your turn to talk?
